summary: Target Hospitality Corp. filed a Form 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders held on May 21, 2026. Stockholders elected directors, ratified Ernst & Young as auditor, approved say-on-pay, and approved an amendment to the 2019 Incentive Plan increasing authorized shares by 4 million. No specific terms (price, premium, close date) were stated; the board did not make a special-situation recommendation. The filing is a routine current report covering shareholder votes and director equity awards, not a special situation.
